notes_for_editor: Name, coordinates and map sheet agree between the tnlandforms list and TopoZone (feature type Tower, Louisville South map). The record's registers field holds the list's GFC coordinate tags (BLL-50814, gfc-619), not register numbers; see the proposed correction. Record elevation 100.3 m matches the list's 329. No build, staffing, fire, status or access source found after two searches and about six page reads (the Jefferson County history page has no mention of a tower; anyplaceamerica.com returned HTTP 403). The status field should stay unknown until someone checks the site.
